# Metadata signal (generated by scripts/05_metadata_and_uncertainty.py)

Cohort: 203 patients (selected slide's specimen age).

| Subtype | Patients | Age mean ± sd | Age median | % female |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In situ | 45 | 47.3 ± 9.2 | 48 | 82% |
| Lepidic | 19 | 55.5 ± 7.4 | 55 | 68% |
| Acinar | 30 | 54.3 ± 10.2 | 54 | 63% |
| Papillary | 39 | 59.9 ± 8.7 | 59 | 69% |
| Micropapillary | 26 | 56.3 ± 8.3 | 56 | 42% |
| Solid | 29 | 56.0 ± 10.3 | 57 | 45% |
| Cribriform | 15 | 63.3 ± 10.3 | 66 | 40% |

- Age ~ subtype, Kruskal-Wallis: H = 42.4, p = 1.5e-07.
- In situ vs. the rest, age (Mann-Whitney): median 48 vs 57, p = 1.7e-08.
- Sex ~ subtype, chi-square: X2 = 20.0, dof = 6, p = 0.0027.

## Metadata-only baseline on development CV (same folds as the agent; test not used)

- Macro AUROC: 0.588 ± 0.086 (fold mean ± sd); pooled out-of-fold 0.554.
- Balanced accuracy (pooled OOF): 0.259; chance = 0.143.
- Accuracy per fold: 0.24, 0.27, 0.28, 0.31, 0.34.

Figures: `figures/age_by_subtype.png`, `figures/female_by_subtype.png`.
